articles.title: Google named a Leader in the External Threat Intelligence Service Forrester Wave
articles.summary: At Google, we see firsthand how the speed, scale, and sophistication of cyber threats continue to challenge traditional enterprise defenses.
articles.detail: Today’s defenders can’t rely on reactive triage or fragmented data feeds; you require high-fidelity intelligence, deep underground visibility, and actionable context to anticipate adversary moves before an attack unfolds.

articles.title: The future of orchestration: Pine59’s journey to Airflow 3 on Google Cloud
articles.summary: Operating large data pipelines requires an orchestration layer that scales smoothly as workloads expand.
articles.detail: When your pipelines process millions of complex data points every day to feed predictive models, staying up-to-date with your technology stack is a strategic necessity.

articles.title: How a solo founder runs a five-continent tender platform on AlloyDB and MCP
articles.summary: Lucius AI, a tender-intelligence startup covering markets across five continents, runs its entire data platform on AlloyDB for PostgreSQL with a single operator.
articles.detail: By migrating semantic search to a ScaNN index and managing database operations through Model Context Protocol (MCP), query latency dropped by 47x while automating day-to-day administrative tasks via MCP.

articles.title: For SeaVerse, GKE Agent Sandbox reduces infrastructure costs by 60%
articles.summary: SeaVerse , a gaming startup from SeaArt that is building a platform for playable AI experiences.
articles.detail: To support that creative loop, SeaVerse needed infrastructure that could run dynamic, multi-tenant sandbox workloads with strong isolation, low latency, and high performance.

articles.title: New low-cost burstable Amazon EC2 T8i instances are generally available
articles.summary: AWS introduces new low-cost burstable Amazon EC2 T8i instances powered by custom sixth generation Intel Xeon Scalable Processors (Granite Rapids).
articles.detail: T8i instances are among the lowest-cost EC2 instances and deliver up to 30% better price performance over previous generation T3 instances.

articles.title: AWS Elastic Beanstalk introduces Cluster Mode
articles.summary: Run an application on AWS Elastic Beanstalk Cluster Mode without provisioning or operating the compute underneath it.
articles.detail: You provide a container image or source code; Elastic Beanstalk with service-operated compute creates and operates the environment that runs it.

articles.title: [In-Depth Look] Choosing the Right AWS Storage Option for Your Workload
articles.summary: AWS provides a wide range of storage options, each designed to meet specific workload requirements.
articles.detail: Understanding the strengths and limitations of each option is crucial for architecting efficient, cost-effective, and high-performance workloads on AWS.
